about.metaDescription: How LA MESA works: free signup, invitation, ACCESS ticket to confirm, negotiated menu on site.
about.title: How it works
about.introLead: One table. One theme. Selected guests, by invitation.
about.introBody: Sign up free. You get an invitation when an evening matches your profile. Once invited, you confirm your seat by paying the ACCESS ticket (~MXN $450 on average; welcome drink / amuse-bouches depending on the edition). The negotiated menu is paid on site.
about.forWho: For decision-makers, founders, investors, and experts who bring something to that evening’s theme. Tables stay small; we mix the room by hand.

steps.1: Sign up free and join the list.
steps.2: Complete your profile so we can propose a table suited to your experience, industry, and the evening’s theme.
steps.3: You get an invitation when an evening matches your profile.
steps.4: Confirm your seat by paying the ACCESS ticket (~MXN $450 on average) within the stated deadline. Inclusions (welcome drink / amuse-bouches) depend on the edition. Negotiated menu = on site, on you.

about.eligibilityNote: The list is the starting point. An invite only comes when a table fits.

seats.a: Small on purpose. Otherwise half the table never speaks.

themes.a: Yes. Each evening has its own theme. Invitations come from people on the list: industry, role, experience, interests. The fuller your profile, the more an evening can fit.

payment.q: How do I confirm my seat?
payment.a: Once you get the invitation, you pay the ACCESS ticket (on average MXN $450) within the stated deadline. If not, the seat is released and offered to someone else.

composition.q: Will I know who else is at the table before I pay?
composition.a: We don’t share a name list: that discretion is part of the table. With the invitation, we do share the makeup: theme, approximate level, sectors or roles. If it doesn’t fit, you simply don’t confirm. No commitment.

price.q: How much does it cost, and who pays?
price.a: Two parts: (1) ACCESS ticket ~MXN $450 / person on average to confirm the seat — exact amount with the invitation; depending on the edition, welcome drink and/or amuse-bouches may be included; (2) negotiated menu and other on-site consumptions, on you (typical estimate MXN $500–$1,500 / person depending on menu, whether drinks are included, and what you order). Except special cases (e.g. a complimentary evening under sponsorship).

absence.q: What if I can’t make it at the last minute?
absence.a: Let us know as soon as you can. Cancel more than 48 hours ahead: refund or credit toward one future evening. Within 48 hours: the payment is kept.

guests.q: Is there sometimes a guest speaker or a sponsor?
guests.a: Sometimes. There may be a guest tied to that evening’s theme, or a sponsorship. It’s stated clearly with the invitation.
